title: Nonlinear Moving-Horizon Estimation Using State- and Control-Dependent Models
summary: This paper presents a state- and control-dependent moving-horizon estimation (SCD-MHE) algorithm for nonlinear discrete-time systems. The nonlinear dynamics and measurement maps are written exactly in pseudo-linear form using state- and control-dependent coefficient (SCDC) matrices. At each time step, the moving-horizon estimation problem is solved by a sequence of sparse quadratic programs, where the SCDC matrices are refrozen along the trajectory computed by the preceding iteration; the estimator requires no Jacobians and retains the nonlinear model exactly.
